source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All TEMP_GB_HSC1~10 should get pass result.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- TEMP_GB_HSC1~10 is a GPU sensor: load the GPU driver first, then run `sudo ipmitool sdr elist` + `sudo ipmitool sensor list`; reading should change with GPU temp. Needs the GPU driver loaded + a temp change (workload) to observe.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the sdr/sensor-list output for TEMP_GB_HSC1~10 showing the reading changes as temp changes + SEL assert/deassert log; user confirms thresholds/spec.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: warming the GPU via workload raises heat; control cooling. Pass/Fail judged by user.
deepseek_columns.remark: same code in 2 workbook rows (multi-row code)

original_test_intent: With the required accelerator driver stack active, exercise and independently verify every TEMP_GB_HSC1 through HSC10 channel across approved warning and critical thresholds, including correct SEL, platform protection, cooldown and recovery.
original_method: An engineer initializes the GPU stack and controls workload or approved thermal conditions while IPMI observes ten HSC channels; the source neither expands HSC nor maps the range to physical components or independent thermal zones.
manual_activity: An engineer defines HSC for this design, maps all ten labels to installed physical components and power/thermal domains, approves a stimulus plan that can demonstrate each applicable channel, and remains present with abort and recovery authority.
required_inputs: HSC definition and HSC1-10 physical component, SDR, accelerator UUID/PCI BDF and board-domain map
installed/applicable channel matrix; missing or unpopulated channels require explicit Project disposition
validated driver, firmware, vendor telemetry and workload/fixture versions
per-channel limits, accuracy, hysteresis, SEL event data and expected fan/throttle/power/device/shutdown response
stimulus-to-channel coupling matrix with ramp, dwell, maximum, abort, cooldown and isolation expectations
independent probes plus, if HSC maps to power switching, rail/current/fault telemetry and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not assume HSC means a particular component class or that one GPU workload thermally exercises all ten channels.

Monitor every applicable HSC plus GPU/component temperatures, power/current/rails where relevant, clocks, throttle reasons, XID/driver, fabric/PCIe links, fans, host and BMC; abort on overshoot, fault, device/link loss or cooling instability.
Account for thermal cross-coupling so a neighboring channel's rise is not credited as target coverage without the approved matrix.
Preserve the first channel-specific SEL, XID, AER, power and driver failure evidence; do not clear logs or automatically retry.
Stop stimulus, restore cooling/power state and verify all channels and devices recover before continuation.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, enumerate exactly HSC1 through HSC10 and bind each sample to its stable SDR, component, device and domain identity.
Run only the approved workload or monitor the engineer-operated fixture while collecting per-channel BMC/SEL, independent probes, accelerator, power, fabric/PCIe, fan and host telemetry.
Produce a ten-row coverage matrix for threshold assert/deassert, protection response, cross-coupling, cooldown and recovery; one channel cannot satisfy another.
Do not invent missing mappings, apply unapproved thermal/power conditions, clear evidence, auto-retry or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the ten-channel topology/applicability, stack, stimulus/coupling plan, event/protection matrix and recovery.
Provide physical oversight and emergency abort during each thermal transition.
Resolve channel-specific anomalies and issue per-channel plus overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It preserves driver/workload prerequisites, but generic sensor lists cannot establish ten identities, stimulate every channel, collect SEL, separate cross-coupling or prove recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted IPMI/SEL collection synchronized with an approved per-channel map, vendor accelerator/power telemetry, stable device identities, independent probes and controlled workload/fixture conditions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The driver note, HSC1~10 range, IPMI commands, dynamic threshold requirement, script and 5/10-minute values remain; Project qualification defines actual channel sequence and duration.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Enumerate all applicable HSC channels, validate stack and stimulus coupling, exercise each required channel or approved coupled group, correlate SEL/protection, and prove per-channel cooldown and device recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact GPU baseboard, HSC population, accelerator/power topology and cooling design.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board revision, each sensor/component/device identity, firmware/driver, BMC/SDR, telemetry tools and stimulus package.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor HSC physical/thermal map, component or power-stage limits, SEL mapping and accelerator recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds ten-channel identity, applicability, coupling/cross-coupling, power-domain evidence when relevant and per-channel recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One changing GPU temperature, a subset of SDRs or a shared SEL event cannot satisfy the explicit all-HSC1~10 criterion.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Ten-channel map, qualified stack/stimulus, limits/events and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A shared workload may unevenly heat channels, and deliberately reaching all critical limits can trigger power or accelerator protection before every sensor crosses.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may define a smaller applicable set only when the actual board population proves some channels are not implemented, and may group channels only with documented coupling/equivalence. Each omitted, grouped or unreachable channel needs an explicit coverage disposition.
expected_evidence: approved driver/workload or fixture plus per-channel coupling, probe and abort plan
timestamped ten-channel BMC and independent temperatures with accelerator, power/rail, clocks/throttling, fan and host state
decoded warning/critical SEL assert/deassert entries separately attributed to every applicable channel
XID, driver, fabric/PCIe AER/link and conditional power-fault evidence
cross-coupling observations, per-channel cooldown/recovery matrix and engineer verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Code Wistron-BMC-00069-V003 is reused at row 1501 for unrelated BIOS WebUI flash. Row 779 remains the HSC thermal variant by physical identity; HSC semantics and population are Project readiness inputs rather than justification to merge rows.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Master explicitly requires all HSC1-10 temperature channels and dynamic threshold behavior. Physical mappings, applicability, driver package and safe stimulus values can be supplied by Project engineering, enabling attended execution and automated per-channel evidence collection.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains PARTIAL but replaces generic GPU warming with a required ten-channel coupling and evidence matrix.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 while retaining per-channel safety gates.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently adds channel applicability, cross-coupling, conditional rail/current/fault evidence and explicit no-substitution coverage.

review_improvement: Turns a range label into ten independently accountable coverage rows and prevents a common workload or one event from masking missing channels.
independent_technical_reasoning: The explicit all-channel criterion makes completeness non-negotiable, but the absent topology does not make the test semantically impossible. Once Project engineering identifies the channels and qualifies how each is stimulated, acquisition and correlation are automatable while physical risk and verdict ownership remain manual.
